notes: Setup: the sandbox had Node v22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24+; installed Node v24.11.1 from nodejs.org into the scratchpad (~3s). Bootstrap npm,submodule,reference with --allow-unpinned-reference took 179s (npm 10.7s, submodule 7.0s, reference 161.6s). Baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+video-operator-registry test: 53s, green (8 tests).
The differential file runs in about 12s with --maxWorkers=1; the unit file in under 1s.

Float-sensitive cases (any weight sum above FLT_EPSILON) are gated to linux-x64 with it.skipIf and constant titles ending 'on linux-x64'. The gate is a precaution taken from the determinism notes (macOS arm64 fuses multiply-adds): no macOS difference was measured here (no macOS host). Identity, refusal and negotiation cases run everywhere; no case is dropped inside a test per platform.
Two mutations, computing in double (no Math.fround) and rounding instead of truncating in av_clip_uint8, each fail all six linux-gated differential tests.

Option values accept full av_expr expressions through compileExpression with the linux-x64 numeric profile, as the shared integer-option helper does; NaN results are refused like native (av_expr_parse_and_eval fails on NaN).

Native negotiates every one of the 17 negotiation sources to a format with storage (gray/YUV -> rgb24, yuva420p -> argb), so registry examples need no format= prefix; three use one anyway to reach the gbrp, rgba and rgb24 kernels.
